hook: In a simulated moire model, doping three different phases always yields the same chiral superconductor.
summary: The authors studied a Hubbard model on a lattice with magnetic flux, which may be realizable in twisted bilayers. DMRG and quantum Monte Carlo simulations find a quantum Hall phase, a chiral spin liquid, and an antiferromagnet, and doping each gives the same chiral superconductor. These are numerical results on a model; no experiment has shown this.
title: Chiral Superconductivity Indifferent to Parent Topology in the Square-Lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard Model
